samples.text: U.S. Chamber of Commerce, which backed John Cornyn in the #TXSEN primary, is coming off the sidelines in the general election and backing Ken Paxton. Part of the push to shore up more traditional GOP
NEW — The U.S. Chamber of Commerce has endorsed Ken Paxton in Texas’ Senate race, per Bloomberg.
JUST IN: US Chamber of Commerce, the nation's largest business lobbying group, officially endorses Ken Paxton in the Texas Senate race.
